name: Arcadium
summary: Arcadium is a browser-based collection of single-player and online multiplayer games designed for desktop and touch controls. Its catalogue combines arcade challenges, puzzles, board games, table sports, 3D racing and four competitive arena modes. Players can face bots or join online rooms for tactical shooting, lane battles, extraction and battle royale matches. Twitch integration lets viewers vote for a game, sign up through chat and, when selected, enter the match in their browser. The Twitch show also provides spectator views for streamed matches. Player accounts retain scores and progression. Compatible single-player games support offline play through the web app.
